name: RCI Industries & Technologies Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1992, RCI Industries & Technologies Ltd manufactures Round and Flat Rolled Copper and Copper Alloys.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
RCITL is a manufacturer of diversified flat and round products in copper, brass and also in stainless steel, and special alloys.
